findings.earliest_end: Section 7 expressly terminates the Commission one year from the order date unless the President extends it beforehand. Both heading and execution date say April 29, 2002, giving April 29, 2003 without month-end ambiguity. Original interim-report deadline is not a cessation; final-report date is assigned by Chair in consultation with President and does not trigger sunset. No actual extension lead appears in the held chain, which does not establish exhaustive absence of non-EO presidential action. EO:13316 sections 3(g),6 explicitly revoke the whole named order effective September 30, 2003, rather than September 17 signing. Machine partial-scope/section-2 labels are contradicted by the complete actor text and correctly rejected.
findings.inventory: All seven complete original sections are retained, including membership subparagraphs, mission details, principles, support/travel/staff/FACA, reports and termination. Section 4 principles bind the Commission in performing its mission; section 3 asks it to formulate options for others, not to implement an independent permanent agency program. Page furniture inside a span does not omit operative text or change exact-source provenance.
limitations: No image inspection was performed; relevant original/actor page-check flags are false.

findings.savings: All operative commands are Commission-dependent. Ordinary travel expenses/compensation may accrue under existing law but the original supplies no independent executive mandate, transfer or savings clause continuing authority after Commission expiration. Producer’s none_after_bounded_search concerns surviving executive authority; it does not purport to cancel accrued statutory rights.
